title: ManageOrganizerOwnerPageCallablePayload
description: Callable payload accepted by manageOrganizerOwnerPage, the website owner view's writes that no existing command covers. setLinks replaces the page's owner links (add, reorder, pin, schedule) through the same owner-link policy as adminUpdateOrganizerDetails. setPhotoOrder reorders the page's existing photos (the first becomes the cover); it never adds or removes one. sendFollowerMessage sends one follower update through createOrganizerPost, at most twice a calendar month per organiser. About goes through updateOrganizer, review replies through setReviewResponse and tracking through setOrganizerTrackingSettings.

links.description: Replaces the organiser page links, in display order. An empty array removes them.

photoIds.description: Every existing photo id, in the new order.
